subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in durable runtime, shared-state schema, environment controls, and public Gateway protocol as the beta3 foundation?
rationale: This PR creates a broad persisted runtime and public operator contract; implementation correctness cannot determine whether that permanent product and ownership direction should be accepted.

options.title: Sponsor the durable foundation
options.body: Approve the shared-state and protocol direction, then require conflict resolution and complete upgrade and runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the beta3 slice
options.body: Keep only the smallest owner-approved storage and runtime primitives while deferring agent, delivery, CLI, and public protocol integration.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Pause or close the cumulative stack until durable-runtime product direction is explicitly planned.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable foundation
recommendation.body: Approve the shared-state and protocol direction, then require conflict resolution and complete upgrade and runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest current history across the Gateway, restart recovery, subagent lifecycle, and delivery surfaces this architectural choice would permanently affect.
